description: List countries with ISO codes, region, income level, lending type, capital, and coordinates, narrowed by region, income_level, lending_type, and text (filter), combined by AND. With source_id, lists that dataset's own entities instead (source_id=50 with filter="Kenya" returns Kenya and its provinces).

filter.description: Text whose every word must appear in an entry's id and name together, ignoring case, diacritics, punctuation, and order; a word may be part of a longer one ("nairobi kenya" matches KEN_Nairobi_Province_KE.NP_51328_KEN004). Aggregates match only with include_aggregates=true. Applied before paging, so the totals count matches; one with no letter or digit is ignored.

include_aggregates.description: Also return regional, income-group, and world aggregates (default false: countries only). No effect with region, income_level, or lending_type, which never return aggregates.

income_level.description: Income group code: LIC (Low), LMC (Lower middle), UMC (Upper middle), or HIC (High income).

lending_type.description: Lending type code: IDX (IDA), IBD (IBRD), IDB (Blend, eligible for both), or LNX (Not classified). worldbank_get_poverty takes IDX, IBD, and IDB for its lending groups.

per_page.description: Results per page (default: server default); sizes above 300 are served at that maximum, with a notice.

region.description: Region code, as region.id reports: EAS (East Asia & Pacific), ECS (Europe & Central Asia), LCN (Latin America & Caribbean), MEA (Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan), NAC (North America), SAS (South Asia), or SSF (Sub-Saharan Africa). Other World Bank region and grouping codes (AFE, AFW, ARB, EUU, LDC, …) filter by membership.

source_id.description: Source ID (from worldbank_list_sources) whose own entities to list, as id, name, and sourceId only. region, income_level, lending_type, and include_aggregates=true are rejected with it (the default false keeps every entity); filter applies.

name: worldbank_list_countries

appliedFilters.description: Parameters in force for this listing; a filter not applied is omitted.

perPage.description: Page size served, after any reduction to the page maximum.

requestedPerPage.description: Page size asked for, or the server default; present only when perPage was reduced.

id.description: Entity ID, which worldbank_get_data takes unchanged.

capitalCity.description: Capital city; empty for aggregates, as are the coordinates.

id.description: Three-character code (USA; SSF for an aggregate).

isAggregate.description: True for a regional or income-group aggregate.

lendingType.description: Lending type name: IDA, IBRD, Blend, Not classified, or Aggregates.

items.description: A country or aggregate, or a source entity.

currentPage.description: Page number; past totalPages when the request ran off the end.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `source_not_found`: source_id does not name a source. `source_not_queryable`: The source lacks a country/series/time layout. `unsupported_source_filter`: Classification filters are combined with source_id. `invalid_filter`: Unknown region or income_level code. `upstream_timeout`: The World Bank Indicators API did not answer within the call's 50-second budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Explains an empty result (which filters matched nothing), a page past the end, or a reduced page size.

title: List World Bank Countries
